profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with React.JS/Redux in ES5 and ES6, Java Spring-boot, Maven, Enzyme and Karma.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Scientist
positions.description:
SeaVision: Worked on Maritime Domain Awareness project that is web based in an Agile setting using Angular.JS, Node.JS for API servers and backend, Redis, MySQL,  Angular Bootstrap, Angular Material, Jasmine for testing, EC2 instances from AMIs.

LMS: Working on a Link Management Project in Agile setting using Maven, Wildfly, Java, Javascript, REST/Web Services, Selenium Web Driver, Angular.JS, Keycloak Authentication and Cucumber & Protractor for testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Wrote Ruby scripts to decode AIS data and information into various formats such as JSON. Worked with Git, GitLab, and Dokuwiki framework.

positions.title: Programming Tutor/ Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Tutor and assist students in introductory and intermediate programming courses at San Diego State University.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Participated in projects aimed at optimizing frame and memory segmentation of the client-facing software. Quality Assurance testing of company software by evaluating use cases and creating test environments. Projects include the ZDA (Zero-Download Ambassador) software, TLS, SSL and cipher testing using virtual machines and PACs, AGs servers.

positions.title: UX/UI Design, Web and Mobile Development Intern
positions.description: Prototyped feature-ready IOS App wireframes and Web applications using Axure. Agile work environment with development using Git version control. Software includes Xcode, Axure, Eclipse ADT, Photoshop. Fixed and worked on web applications that were based off of PHP, Zend, Smarty and MySql and the API called Retailigence.

positions.title: Junior Embryologist/IVF Technician
positions.description:
Assist with patient retrieval surgeries and transfer operations. 
Prepare laboratory embryo washing and checking media for procedures such as assisted hatching, Intracellular Sperm Inject, biopsies, retrievals and transfers. 
Run blood tests to screen for pregnancy and various hormone levels in patients.
Supply management of laboratory supplies as well as reimbursement on supply orders.
Checking patients in for collection and sperm wash.

positions.title: Crime Lab Student Intern
positions.description:
Performing mock tests on standard blood, semen or saliva sample evidence.
Processing of Sexual Assault barcodes and updating of the barcode database.
Making various kits such as suspect and victim SART kits and mouth reference kits.
Quality Control of lab supplies and working benches.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I organized events, training and orientation for a group of 300+ student and adult volunteers to prepare for an annual Lunar New Year festival in San Diego.
I planned appreciation banquets and social picnics for volunteers and other staffs on the VAYA board.
I volunteered at a clinic ran by UCSD students that provided free healthcare, screenings and checkups to local residents and transients.
